ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: in the figure, the vertical axis is solar altitude, and the horizontal axis is Beijing Time; the two daily variation curves of solar altitude, a and b, are both arched, and the highest points of the two curves both fall on the same vertical line. This vertical line is marked as 14:40 on the horizontal axis, indicating that the solar altitude reaches its maximum at 14:40 Beijing Time, that is, the local noon at place Z corresponds to 14:40 Beijing Time. Reasoning: Beijing Time is based on the local time of 120°E. If the local noon at place Z occurs at 14:40 Beijing Time, while the Beijing Time noon corresponding to 120°E is 12:00, then noon at place Z is 2 hours and 40 minutes later than Beijing Time noon. Each 1-hour difference in longitude corresponds to 15°, and 2 hours and 40 minutes is 2.666... hours, corresponding to about 40° of longitude difference. The local time at place Z is later, indicating that it is west of 120°E, so the longitude is about 120°E－40°＝80°E. 80°E passes near India, so place Z might be located in India.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中a、b两条太阳高度曲线的峰值都出现在北京时间14:40，说明Z地当地正午对应北京时间14:40。再根据地方时差计算经度：Z地正午比120°E的北京时间正午晚2小时40分，所以Z地在120°E以西约40°，经度约80°E。最后查找或回忆位于80°E附近的国家，印度符合，因此Z地可能位于印度。

推理：北京时间以120°E地方时为基准。若Z地当地正午发生在北京时间14:40，而120°E对应的北京时间正午为12:00，则Z地正午比北京时间正午晚2小时40分。经度每相差1小时对应15°，2小时40分即2.666...小时，对应约40°经度差。Z地地方时较晚，说明位于120°E以西，所以经度约为120°E－40°＝80°E。80°E附近经过印度，因此Z地可能位于印度。
